annotations.title: When shal these things be.
annotations.text: The miseries which did fall before the destruction of the Temple and citie of Hierusalem, were a resemblance of the extreme calamitie that shal befall before the later day at the time of Antichrist: wherevpon Christ speaketh indifferently of both.

annotations.title: I am he.
annotations.text: ◦ As before the destruction of Hierusalem, diuerse Seducers arose, and called them selues Christes, promising the people deliuerance from the feares and dangers they were in of forraine souldiars: so shal there come many towards the end of the world, and make them selues Christes and Authors of Sectes, and shal gaine many Disciples: as in plaine wordes foloweth in this chapter v. 22. There shal rise vp False-Christs and False-Prophets &c.

annotations.title: The abomination of desolation.
annotations.text: No heresie doth so properly and purposely tend to this abomination of desolation <mn>[1]</mn> which by Antichrist shal be atchieued, as this <mn>[2]</mn> Caluinisme: which taketh away with other Sacraments and external worship of God, the very sacrifice of Christes Body and bloud. Which being taken away (as S. Cyprian saith) no religion can remaine.

notes.text: Hyppolyt. li. de Antichristo. Cypr. de Coen. Do. nu. 2.
Caluinisme tendeth to the abomination of desolation.

annotations.title: Signes and Wonders.
annotations.text: False-Christes and False-Prophets be seducers, who in the later day by the power of the diuel shal seeme to worke wonders, and yet men must not beleeue them. Much lesse these, which for their false faith can not shew so much as one false miracle.
